answer_1.quote: Question generation (QG), focusing on the questions derived from specific text passages or documents, plays an integral role in a wide array of domains.

answer_2.quote: We use Rouge-L score , BERTScore , and BLEURT  to measure the quality of generated questions.

answer_4.quote: We hire five annotators, proficient in English as their first foreign language, to further evaluate the diversity and quality of the generated questions.
answer_4.guideline: For each question set, the annotators rank the three models on a scale of 1 (highest) to 3 (lowest) based on three dimensions of diversity: type—whether the three selected questions have different question types; syntax—whether the three selected questions use different syntax; and content—whether the three selected questions need to be addressed with diverse answers.
